name: Software Engineer
shortDescription: Designs, builds, and maintains software systems and applications.
description: Software engineers translate ideas and requirements into working code, solving technical problems through logical, structured reasoning while building and testing systems that others will use.

name: Data Scientist
shortDescription: Analyzes complex data to uncover patterns and inform decisions.
description: Data scientists combine statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract insight from large datasets, building models and reports that guide business or research decisions.

name: Mechanical Engineer
shortDescription: Designs and tests mechanical systems, machines, and devices.
description: Mechanical engineers apply physics and materials science to design, build, and refine machines and mechanical systems, balancing hands-on prototyping with rigorous technical analysis.

name: Civil Engineer
shortDescription: Plans and oversees construction of infrastructure like roads, bridges, and buildings.
description: Civil engineers design and supervise the construction of public infrastructure, working within safety codes and regulations while coordinating with contractors and communities.

name: Electrician
shortDescription: Installs, maintains, and repairs electrical systems and wiring.
description: Electricians work hands-on with electrical systems in homes, buildings, and equipment, following strict codes and safety procedures to diagnose and fix problems.

name: Automotive Technician
shortDescription: Diagnoses and repairs vehicle mechanical and electrical issues.
description: Automotive technicians use hands-on skill and diagnostic reasoning to identify and fix problems in vehicles, working with tools, equipment, and increasingly complex onboard electronics.

name: Registered Nurse
shortDescription: Provides direct patient care and supports treatment plans.
description: Registered nurses care for patients in hospitals, clinics, and other settings, combining clinical knowledge with hands-on procedures and compassionate, attentive communication.

name: Physician (Family Medicine)
shortDescription: Diagnoses and treats a wide range of patient health conditions.
description: Family physicians assess symptoms, diagnose conditions, and manage ongoing patient care, relying on strong analytical reasoning and direct, empathetic interaction with patients.

name: Physical Therapist
shortDescription: Helps patients recover movement and manage physical pain.
description: Physical therapists design and guide hands-on rehabilitation programs, working directly with patients to restore mobility and strength after injury or illness.

name: Biomedical Researcher
shortDescription: Conducts laboratory research to advance medical science.
description: Biomedical researchers design experiments, analyze data, and investigate biological questions in a lab setting, driven by curiosity and rigorous scientific method.

name: Environmental Scientist
shortDescription: Studies ecosystems and environmental data to inform policy and protection.
description: Environmental scientists collect and analyze data on air, water, soil, and ecosystems, often combining fieldwork with research to guide conservation and regulatory decisions.

name: Veterinarian
shortDescription: Diagnoses and treats health conditions in animals.
description: Veterinarians examine, diagnose, and treat animals, combining medical reasoning with hands-on procedures and communication with animal owners.

name: Financial Analyst
shortDescription: Evaluates financial data to guide investment and business decisions.
description: Financial analysts study markets, financial statements, and trends to build models and recommendations that guide investment or business strategy.

name: Accountant
shortDescription: Manages financial records and ensures regulatory compliance.
description: Accountants prepare, review, and analyze financial records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with tax and reporting requirements.

name: Actuary
shortDescription: Uses statistics and probability to assess and price financial risk.
description: Actuaries apply advanced mathematics and statistical modeling to assess risk for insurance and financial products, working carefully within rigorous professional standards.

name: Marketing Manager
shortDescription: Plans and leads campaigns to promote products or brands.
description: Marketing managers develop strategies and creative campaigns to reach audiences, blending persuasive leadership with an understanding of consumer behavior.

name: Sales Manager
shortDescription: Leads a sales team and drives revenue growth.
description: Sales managers set targets, coach a sales team, and build client relationships, combining persuasive leadership with organized tracking of performance.

name: Human Resources Manager
shortDescription: Oversees hiring, employee relations, and workplace policy.
description: HR managers support employees and organizational leadership by managing hiring, conflict resolution, and workplace policy, balancing people-focused care with administrative structure.

name: Entrepreneur / Small Business Owner
shortDescription: Starts and runs an independent business venture.
description: Entrepreneurs identify opportunities and build businesses from the ground up, taking on varied responsibilities from strategy and finances to marketing and operations.

name: Lawyer
shortDescription: Advises and represents clients on legal matters.
description: Lawyers research law, build arguments, and advocate for clients, combining sharp analytical reasoning with persuasive communication in negotiations and court.

name: Paralegal
shortDescription: Supports lawyers by preparing documents and conducting legal research.
description: Paralegals organize case files, conduct legal research, and draft documents, providing the detailed, structured support that keeps legal work on track, while also coordinating with clients and attorneys.

name: Elementary School Teacher
shortDescription: Teaches and nurtures young children's early learning.
description: Elementary teachers design engaging lessons and support young students' academic and social development, blending creativity with classroom leadership.

name: High School Science Teacher
shortDescription: Teaches science concepts and skills to teenage students.
description: Science teachers explain and demonstrate scientific concepts, design experiments and lessons, and guide students in developing analytical thinking skills.

name: School Counselor
shortDescription: Supports students' academic, social, and emotional development.
description: School counselors guide students through academic planning and personal challenges, offering empathetic support tailored to each student's needs.

name: Graphic Designer
shortDescription: Creates visual content for brands, print, and digital media.
description: Graphic designers craft visual communication -- logos, layouts, and digital graphics -- combining artistic vision with technical execution using design tools.

name: UI/UX Designer
shortDescription: Designs how people interact with digital products.
description: UI/UX designers research user needs and design intuitive digital interfaces, balancing creative visual design with structured, research-driven problem solving.

name: Architect
shortDescription: Designs buildings and spaces that are functional and visually compelling.
description: Architects design structures and spaces, balancing creative vision with technical knowledge of materials, structure, and building codes.

name: Journalist
shortDescription: Researches and writes news and feature stories.
description: Journalists investigate stories, interview sources, and write compelling narratives, combining storytelling craft with the drive to pursue and verify information.

name: Public Relations Specialist
shortDescription: Manages public image and messaging for organizations or clients.
description: PR specialists build media relationships and manage public perception, combining persuasive communication with creative content development.

name: Social Worker
shortDescription: Supports individuals and families facing personal or social challenges.
description: Social workers advocate for and support vulnerable individuals and families, connecting them with resources and navigating complex personal and systemic challenges.

name: Urban Planner
shortDescription: Designs land use and development plans for communities.
description: Urban planners analyze data and community needs to guide how land, infrastructure, and public spaces are developed, balancing research with public engagement.

name: Chef
shortDescription: Creates and prepares dishes and leads a professional kitchen.
description: Chefs combine hands-on culinary craft with creative menu development, often leading a fast-paced kitchen team under pressure.

name: Musician
shortDescription: Performs, composes, or produces music professionally.
description: Musicians develop and perform musical work, expressing creativity through composition, performance, or production, often building a career through practice and independent work.

name: Police Officer
shortDescription: Protects public safety and enforces laws in the community.
description: Police officers patrol communities, respond to incidents, and enforce laws, combining physical readiness with decisive judgment and direct community interaction.
